description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 9 (Accessibility Pt. 5 - Play Equipment) for the Otterfield Road phase of planning permission reference 76795/APP/2023/2503 dated 02-09-2024 for 'Demolition of existing Yiewsley Library Building and the erection of a new residential building on the Yiewsley Library site (Falling Lane) and the erection of a new mixed use building on the former Yiewsley Swimming Pool site (Otterfield Road), with a replacement library at ground floor level, residential uses above and new pedestrian access off of the High Street.'
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The applicant is reminded that parts 1 to 4 of Condition 9 are compliance elements and therefore are unable to be discharged.
site_name: LAND AT YIEWSLEY LIBRARY & FORMER YIEWSLEY POOL FALLING LANE
